### Verification
Before submitting a new documentation suggestion please verify and check the following:
- [ ] I checked if the docs exists on the newest version from the main branch
- [ ] I checked if there is no similar suggestion already submitted

### Documentation element/s
What part of the documentation needs to be updated or added?

### Why is it needed?
Explain the importance of this update/addition.

### Suggested changes
Provide a detailed description of the changes.

### Additional context
Any relevant screenshots, links, and/or resources.
